commit.subject: LU-19014 osc: unplug IO synchronously in high priority
commit.message:
LU-19014 osc: unplug IO synchronously in high priority

Flush the extent ASAP during osc_release. Otherwise it could
leave an extent in wrong state.
Also make the cache writeback more reliable.

Fixes: c413d2ede5 ("LU-19014 memcg: fix client hang in balance_dirty_pages()")
Signed-off-by: Yang Sheng <ys@whamcloud.com>
Change-Id: Ie6f9cefcbf50c02c2fdf7a26fcde874675609d10
